title: Add log/trace correlation deep links for incident context
author: Allison Grant
description: Summary: Adds standardized log/trace correlation shortcuts (deep links) that incident-bot v2 and Console can embed for fast drill-down during incidents. This PR introduces a small, versioned link-template bundle in observability-pack plus validation tests to ensure URLs remain stable across releases. Motivation: In beta incident-bot v2 threads we repeatedly saw responders copy/paste request IDs and hunt manually across systems. We already link to dashboards (burn rate, deploy timeline, saturation), but we were missing the 1-click “take me to logs for this trace/request in the right time window” experience. This closes that gap while keeping URLs tenant-safe. Details: (1) Adds link templates for Traces and Logs with consistent parameter names and time windows, with support for service/route/region, optional trace_id, and optional request_id. (2) Adds a tiny resolver helper (used by bot + Console) that renders templates and URL-encodes values consistently (spaces, slashes, and ':' were common footguns). (3) Provides a default time window policy: incident_ts +/- 15m for traces and incident_ts +/- 30m for logs, configurable per caller. (4) Adds redaction/guardrails: tenant identifiers are not included in links by default; if provided, they must be hashed (tenant_hash) and only used in pre-approved queries. This mirrors the incident-bot v2 permissions/audit model and keeps deep links safe to paste into Slack. (5) Documents the deep-link contract in README so incident-bot and Console stay aligned. Example rendered links (staging): Trace UI: https://observability.redwood.example/traces?from=1719830400000&to=1719832200000&service=hosted-api&region=us-east-1&trace_id=7f3b0d2f3c5a4f01 Logs UI: https://observability.redwood.example/logs?from=1719830100000&to=1719832500000&service=hosted-api&region=us-east-1&query=request_id%3D%22req_01HT...%22 Notes for incident-bot integration: incident-bot should prefer trace_id when present (highest signal, lowest ambiguity) and fall back to request_id. The query string is intentionally constrained to avoid high-cardinality fields and accidental PII. Follow-ups: (a) once incident-bot PR-1862 lands, wire these links into the context payload schema under links.logs and links.traces; (b) after GA, we can add a third shortcut for “logs around rollout events” keyed by deploy_id (needs release-engineering join).
commits: 1) Add correlation link templates + schema validation 2) Implement URL rendering helper with canonical encoding 3) Add unit tests + golden snapshots for common incident inputs 4) Docs: deep-link contract + examples for incident-bot/Console consumers
ci_summary: Checks: lint (pass), unit-tests (pass), typecheck (pass), pack-validate (pass), link-schema-validate (pass)
review_conversation: Logan Wright: Can we ensure these links don’t accidentally introduce expensive queries (e.g., regex on message) when the bot pastes them repeatedly? Author (Allison): Yes—templates only allow exact-match filters on request_id/trace_id and stable dimensions (service/region). No free-form user query; fixtures cover encoding and quoting. Caleb Johnson: The trace link should not include request_id unless trace_id is missing, otherwise we end up with confusing multi-filter results. Author: Agreed; updated docs to say callers should prefer trace_id and only pass request_id as fallback. Also updated resolver helper example accordingly. Miles Thornton: Please confirm tenant safety. We had feedback that links pasted into #incidents must not include raw tenant IDs. Author: Added guardrail: tenant_id is rejected by schema; only tenant_hash is permitted and is optional. Docs note that bot should omit tenant filters unless strictly needed. Chloe Martin: Console needs stable parameter names; can we lock “from/to/service/region/trace_id/request_id”? Author: Locked in v1 schema and added a changelog note that breaking changes require v2 templates. Added golden test to ensure parameter names are consistent.
merge_outcome: Merged (squash) by Allison Grant into main
release_notes: Observability-pack now ships versioned correlation deep links for logs/traces (v1) suitable for embedding in incident-bot context cards and Console incident views.
